# LWC Group

> LWC Group (Pty) Ltd — "King of Engineering Solutions". A South African engineering and technology company that helps businesses, mines and industrial operations improve performance, reduce costs and make better decisions. It works across South Africa and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), in English and French.

LWC Group turns engineering, data and technology into practical solutions that deliver measurable results. The company combines engineering, artificial intelligence, data, metallurgy, simulation and digital design under one roof, organised into four divisions.

## Divisions

- [Engineering](https://lwcgroup.jlwanalytics.com/engineering): Mining, metallurgy and process optimisation — mineral processing, extractive metallurgy, hydrometallurgy, metal recovery, metallurgical accounting and plant efficiency.
- [Intelligence](https://lwcgroup.jlwanalytics.com/intelligence): AI, data, automation and simulation — dashboards, forecasting, predictive models, anomaly detection, optimisation and digital twins.
- [Digital](https://lwcgroup.jlwanalytics.com/digital): Premium websites, 3D experiences, commercial video and AI-assisted advertising in English and French.
- [Academy](https://lwcgroup.jlwanalytics.com/academy): Research mentoring, technical support, AI research-workflow automation, and training/workshops for postgraduate students and professionals — ethically, never doing the client's work for them.
